units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b:4">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>ואם שכרו ת׳ וכ׳</he> if the caravan hired a scout to go before it; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:13">Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 13</cite>; Y. ib. VI, end, 11ᵃ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:11">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הת׳ הגדול</he>, v. <cite ref="V00271"><he>תּוּר</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּיָּירִים</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 983:10">Yalk. Cant. 983</cite> (play on <he>בתורים</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:10">Cant. I, 10</cite>) <he>שני תורת נעשו ת׳ טובים לישראל</he> (read: <he>שתי תורות</he>) two laws (the written and the oral) became good guides for Israel.
